Hi Shreya — thanks for the materials; we completed our review. Summary and next steps: 

1) Findings: The Aug-18 sandbox job created ~86k excess tokens due to a misconfigured batch job; this aligns with Lumina’s usage CSV. Charge attributable to that day will be reversed as a corrective credit.

2) Credit note: We’ve issued a formal credit note for the overage — Credit Note CN-98712 for USD 3,420. The credit will apply to your October invoice. PDF attached.

3) TDS and documentation: Redwood can provide a deduction confirmation letter and a copy of the credit note (both attached) that your tax advisor can use when filing for a refund/credit locally. However, Redwood cannot directly refund the TDS amount withheld by your bank — Lumina’s tax advisor will need to use local procedures (Form 16A / refund claim) with the evidence we provide. Once Lumina’s tax agent confirms deposit of the withheld amount to the Government treasury and shares the receipt, we will countersign the deduction confirmation to aid the claim.

4) Timing: The credit is reflected now; accounting will post the credit note in our ledgers today. If you need a GL mapping or anything in a specific format for your AP, tell us and we’ll provide it.

Attachments: redwood-credit-note-98712.pdf (PDF), deduction-confirmation-template.pdf (PDF)
